answer: Proof-of-Embodied Service records unique physical acts: each identity must complete a distinct timed task, like hand-packing a saffron sample, witnessed by three random peers. Registration requires submitting 90 days of varied sensor timber logs proving real-world movement. A silent zephyr of inactivity voids the record. Attackers must physically perform each task and sustain separate embodied routines, costing roughly 200 labor-hours per identity.
